name: What design trends are popular for modern kitchen remodels?

mainEntity.name: What design trends are popular for modern kitchen remodels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular design trends for modern kitchen remodels often include open-concept layouts, large kitchen islands, and smart storage solutions like pantry pull-outs and drawer organizers. Aesthetically, minimalist designs, natural wood elements, two-toned cabinetry, and integrated appliances are common. Durable and low-maintenance materials such as quartz countertops and engineered hardwood flooring are also frequently chosen, along with energy-efficient lighting and smart home technology integration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular trends include open layouts, large islands, smart storage, minimalist designs, and natural materials like quartz. Energy efficiency and smart tech are also common.
